title: Portfolio
description: A group of projects, programmes and other portfolios selected, prioritised and overseen together against strategic objectives: a strategic investment and prioritisation construct. What it holds need not depend on one another or share a benefit (that is a programme); what it holds declares itself so, as programme membership is declared. Its decisions (what to invest in, hold or stop, and in what order) are a file of their own, PortfolioDecisions. See TAXONOMY.md D32.

aim.description: What this portfolio invests in, and to what end, in a sentence: the strategic purpose its selection and prioritisation serve. Not a change it brings about itself; that is what a programme has.

objectives.description: The strategic objectives this portfolio is selected and prioritised against: goals at the goal or objective level (a kind rule). What it holds is judged by how it advances these, not by depending on one another.

leadTeam.description: The team that governs the portfolio: selects what goes in, sets priorities and decides what to invest in, hold or stop.

funding.description: The budgets this portfolio allocates. A thing it holds may draw on its own besides.

reviewCycle.description: How often the portfolio's decisions are reviewed. Optional; without one, the decisions' own dates say when they were last made.

portfolios.description: The portfolios this one is part of. Declared here and read back on the parent, as everything a portfolio holds is. A tree: a portfolio that would contain itself is refused.
